title: Prefix evaluation at an adjoined root
statement: Let $m,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^\ell$, let $r$ be a natural number, and let $\alpha$ be a root adjoined for $f_m(X)=X^\ell+\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1}m_iX^i$. The prefix of length $r$ is the sum $\sum_{i=0}^{r-1} c_i\alpha^i$ in the quotient algebra, where $c_i$ is the binary coefficient of $y$ at index $i$.
caveat: The definition of the coefficient-at-index function is not supplied, so the meaning of $c_i$ beyond that name is uncertain.
